g.text: Success: exact marker only, in a completed ordinary final answer. Tool = tool-call stop; cens. = length cap (kept in denominator).
Bars: Wilson 95% intervals. Paired differences use a trace bootstrap in the CSV. This endpoint is not AgentDojo attack success rate.
